```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Working directory = `code/` (where this Rmd and helperFunctions/ live)
get_code_dir <- function() {
  inp <- knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)
  if (!is.null(inp) && nzchar(inp)) return(normalizePath(inp))

  if (requireNamespace("rstudioapi", quietly = TRUE) &&
      rstudioapi::isAvailable()) {
    p <- rstudioapi::getActiveDocumentContext()$path
    if (nzchar(p)) return(normalizePath(dirname(p)))
  }

  if (file.exists("./helperFunctions/Rutilities.R")) return(normalizePath("."))
  if (file.exists("./code/helperFunctions/Rutilities.R")) {
    return(normalizePath("./code"))
  }

  stop(
    "Could not find `code/`. Open `code/Ranalyses.Rproj`, or run from the repo with wd at panAsp-GEM."
  )
}

code_dir <- get_code_dir()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = code_dir)
setwd(code_dir)
```

# Figure 1B

```{r}
# Create data
data <- data.frame(
  name = factor(c("oryzae","niger","fumigatus","KEGG"), 
                levels = c("oryzae","niger","fumigatus","KEGG")),  
  value = c(1310,22,89,578)
)

plt <- ggplot(data, aes(x=as.factor(name), y=value, fill=as.factor(name))) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width=0.5) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  theme_light() +
  theme(legend.title=element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_text(vjust = -1.5)) +
  ylab("Number of reactions") +
  xlab("Annotation source")

png("../data/figures/plot_annotation.png", width = 4, height = 3, units = "in", res = 600)
plt
dev.off()
```

# Figure 1D

Pathways and numbers were obtained from script *p2_constructEnsemble.ipynb*

```{r}
pathways <- c('Fatty acid biosynthesis',
              'Metabolism of xenobiotics by cytochrome P450',
              'Arginine and proline metabolism',
              'Steroid hormone biosynthesis',
              'Cysteine and methionine metabolism',
              'Arachidonic acid metabolism',
              'Tyrosine metabolism',
              'Valine, leucine and isoleucine degradation',
              'Fatty acid degradation',
              'Glycine, serine and threonine metabolism')

data <- data.frame(
  pathways = factor(pathways, levels = rev(pathways)),
  reactions = c(38,34,18,18,17,15,10,10, 9,9),
  genes = c(4,7,4,10,4,1,6,3,3,4)
)

# pathways <- c('Metabolism of xenobiotics by cytochrome P450',
#               'Steroid hormone biosynthesis',
#               'Arachidonic acid metabolism',
#               'Arginine and proline metabolism',
#               'Cysteine and methionine metabolism',
#               'Valine, leucine and isoleucine degradation',
#               'Purine metabolism',
#               'Cyanoamino acid metabolism',
#               'Tryptophan metabolism',
#               'Retinol metabolism')
# 
# data <- data.frame(
#   pathways = factor(pathways, levels = rev(pathways)),
#   reactions = c(39, 23, 16, 15, 11, 11, 10, 10, 9, 9),
#   genes = c(6, 5, 5, 9, 5, 7, 3, 4, 7, 5)
# )

# Reshape the data to long format
data_long <- data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(reactions, genes), names_to = "Type", values_to = "count") %>%
  mutate(Type = factor(Type, levels = c("reactions", "genes")),
         # Create a numeric version of the pathways for plotting
         y_numeric = as.numeric(pathways)) %>%
  mutate(offset = ifelse(Type == "reactions", 0.2, -0.2))  # Add an offset for genes to stack them

# Create the lollipop plot
plt <- ggplot(data_long, aes(x = count, y = y_numeric + offset, color = Type)) +
  # Plot the segments for reactions and genes
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = count, y = y_numeric + offset, yend = y_numeric + offset), size = 0.5) +
  # Plot the points for reactions and genes
  geom_point(aes(x = count, y = y_numeric + offset), size = 4, alpha = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("blue", "darkolivegreen4")) +  # Set colors for reactions and genes
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = unique(data_long$y_numeric),  # Ensure the breaks are unique numeric values for pathways
    labels = rev(levels(data$pathways))  # Use the factor levels as labels
  ) +  # Set y-axis labels to pathways
  theme_light() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10)),  # Add margin to x-axis label
    axis.title.x.top = element_blank(),  # Make sure there is no top axis title
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.12, face = "bold"),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)  # Add margin to the plot to avoid clipping
  ) +
  xlab("Number of reactions/genes") +
  ylab("Pathways") +
  ggtitle("Top 10 enriched pathways")

plt

png("../data/figures/plot_pathways.png", width = 8, height = 4, units = "in", res = 600)
plt
dev.off()
```

# HeatMaps

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(openxlsx)
library(circlize)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(matrixStats)
```

## Read and wrangle Biolog raw data

```{r}
csv_Files <- list.files(path = "../data/biolog/Raw", 
                        pattern = "\\.csv$",
                        full.names = TRUE)

raw_data <- lapply(csv_Files, function(x){
    data = read.csv(x)
    tail(data, n=1) # select the last time point
})
raw_data <- do.call(rbind, raw_data)

# Remove unwanted columns
raw_data$Plate.File <- raw_data$Setup.Time <- raw_data$Position <-  NULL
raw_data$Field.1 <- raw_data$Field.3 <- raw_data$Field.4 <- raw_data$Hour <- NULL

# Update colname
colnames(raw_data)[which(colnames(raw_data) == "Plate.Type")] <- "Plate"

# Clean isolate names
raw_data$Field.2 <- gsub(" ", "_", raw_data$Field.2)

# Establish a baseline
raw_data$baseline <- NA
cols_to_consider <- grep("^([A-H][0-9]{2})$", names(raw_data), value = TRUE)
for (i in 1:nrow(raw_data)) {
    raw_data$baseline[i] <- mean(sort(unlist(raw_data[i,cols_to_consider]))[1:10])
}
```

```{r}
raw_data[,3:98] <- sweep(raw_data[,3:98], 1, raw_data$baseline, FUN = "-")
raw_data$baseline <- NULL
raw_data$Field.2 <- paste0(raw_data$Field.2, rep(c("_1","_2","_3"),24))

data_long <- pivot_longer(data = raw_data, cols = c(3:98))

# Load BioLog assay results (for each plate)
PM_01_wide <- read.csv("../data/biolog/Results_PM01.csv")
PM_02_wide <- read.csv("../data/biolog/Results_PM02.csv")
PM_03_wide <- read.csv("../data/biolog/Results_PM03.csv")

# get link between plate-well and medium
wellDf1 <- data.frame(Medium = colnames(PM_01_wide),
                      Plate = "PM01",
                      Well = substr(colnames(PM_01_wide),1,3))
wellDf2 <- data.frame(Medium = colnames(PM_02_wide),
                      Plate = "PM02A",
                      Well = substr(colnames(PM_02_wide),1,3))
wellDf3 <- data.frame(Medium = colnames(PM_03_wide),
                      Plate = "PM03B",
                      Well = substr(colnames(PM_03_wide),1,3))
wellDfall <- rbind(wellDf1,wellDf2,wellDf3)
wellDfall <- wellDfall[-which(wellDfall$Well == "X"),]

# add medium
data_long <- merge(wellDfall, data_long, by.x = c("Well", "Plate"), by.y = c("name", "Plate"))
data_long$Medium <- paste0(data_long$Medium, "_", data_long$Plate)
data_long$Well <- data_long$Plate <- NULL
colnames(data_long)[2] <- "Strain"
```

```{r}
# Convert to wide format using pivot_wider
wide_df <- data_long %>% pivot_wider(names_from = Strain, values_from = value)
wide_df <- as.data.frame(wide_df)
rownames(wide_df) <- wide_df$Medium
wide_df$Medium <- NULL

# Create the histogram
hist(unlist(wide_df), 
     main = "Histogram of All Values", 
     xlab = "Value", 
     ylab = "Frequency", 
     col = "skyblue", 
     border = "black")
```

```{r}
wide_df_bin <- wide_df %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ case_when(
    . < 60 ~ 0,
    . <= 120 ~ 0.5,
    . > 120 ~ 1
  )))
```

## Figure 3 updated (strain-summarized across replicates)

```{r}
# One column per strain, computed from replicate columns:
# red = 3/3 replicates > 60
# light red = 2/3 replicates > 60
# grey = 1/3 replicates > 60
# black = 0/3 replicates > 60

data_long_strain <- data_long %>%
  mutate(Strain_base = sub("_[123]$", "", Strain)) %>%
  group_by(Medium, Strain_base) %>%
    summarise(
    n_activity  = sum(value > 120, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_ambiguous = sum(value >= 60 & value <= 120, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_noact     = sum(value < 60, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    category = case_when(
      n_activity == 3 & n_ambiguous == 0 & n_noact == 0 ~ "Activity",
      n_activity == 2 & n_ambiguous == 1 & n_noact == 0 ~ "Probable activity",
      n_activity == 2 & n_ambiguous == 0 & n_noact == 1 ~ "Probable activity failed replicate",
      n_activity == 1 & n_ambiguous == 2 & n_noact == 0 ~ "Possibly activity",
      n_activity == 1 & n_ambiguous == 1 & n_noact == 1 ~ "Contradictory",
      n_activity == 1 & n_ambiguous == 0 & n_noact == 2 ~ "Probable no activity failed replicate",
      n_activity == 0 & n_ambiguous == 3 & n_noact == 0 ~ "Ambiguous",
      n_activity == 0 & n_ambiguous == 2 & n_noact == 1 ~ "Possibly no activity",
      n_activity == 0 & n_ambiguous == 1 & n_noact == 2 ~ "Probable no activity",
      n_activity == 0 & n_ambiguous == 0 & n_noact == 3 ~ "No activity",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# Convert categories to numeric codes for plotting
category_levels <- c(
  "No activity",
  "Probable no activity",
  "Possibly no activity",
  "Ambiguous",
  "Probable no activity failed replicate",
  "Contradictory",
  "Possibly activity",
  "Probable activity failed replicate",
  "Probable activity",
  "Activity"
)

data_long_strain$code <- match(data_long_strain$category, category_levels)

wide_df_strain <- data_long_strain %>%
  select(Medium, Strain_base, code) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Strain_base, values_from = code)

wide_df_strain <- as.data.frame(wide_df_strain)
rownames(wide_df_strain) <- wide_df_strain$Medium
wide_df_strain$Medium <- NULL

# Colors corresponding to your table
category_colors <- c(
  "black",       # No activity
  "darkgrey",    # Probable no activity
  "lightgrey",   # Possibly no activity
  "white",       # Ambiguous
  "darkgrey",    # Probable no activity, failed replicate
  "purple",      # Contradictory
  "pink",      # Possibly activity
  "lightcoral",  # Probable activity, failed replicate
  "lightcoral",  # Probable activity
  "red"          # Activity
)

col_fun_strain <- colorRamp2(
  seq_along(category_colors),
  category_colors
)

data_C <- data_long_strain %>%
  filter(grepl("PM01|PM02A", Medium))

data_N <- data_long_strain %>%
  filter(grepl("PM03B", Medium))

wide_C <- data_C %>%
  select(Medium, Strain_base, code) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Strain_base, values_from = code)

wide_N <- data_N %>%
  select(Medium, Strain_base, code) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Strain_base, values_from = code)

wide_C <- as.data.frame(wide_C)
rownames(wide_C) <- wide_C$Medium
wide_C$Medium <- NULL

wide_N <- as.data.frame(wide_N)
rownames(wide_N) <- wide_N$Medium
wide_N$Medium <- NULL


rownames(wide_C) <- update_colnames(rownames(wide_C))
rownames(wide_C) <- sub("^Negative Control _PM01$", "Negative Control (PM01)", rownames(wide_C))
rownames(wide_C) <- sub("^Negative Control _PM02A$", "Negative Control (PM02A)", rownames(wide_C))
rownames(wide_C) <- sub(" _(PM01|PM02A)$", "", rownames(wide_C))
colnames(wide_C) <- sub("_", " ", colnames(wide_C))

rownames(wide_N) <- update_colnames(rownames(wide_N))
rownames(wide_N) <- sub(" _(PM03B)$", "", rownames(wide_N))
colnames(wide_N) <- sub("_", " ", colnames(wide_N))



vis_strain_C <- Heatmap(
  as.matrix(wide_C),
  col = col_fun_strain,
  row_title = "Carbon source",
  column_title = "Strain",
  show_heatmap_legend = FALSE,
  row_names_max_width = grid::unit(8, "cm")
)

vis_strain_N <- Heatmap(
  as.matrix(wide_N),
  col = col_fun_strain,
  row_title = "Nitrogen source",
  column_title = "Strain",
  show_heatmap_legend = FALSE,
  row_names_max_width = grid::unit(8, "cm")
)

vis_strain_C

vis_strain_N
```

```{r}
svg("../data/biolog/BioLog_heatmap_all_strainSummary_C.svg", width = 12, height = 40)
draw(vis_strain_C)
dev.off()

svg("../data/biolog/BioLog_heatmap_all_strainSummary_N.svg", width = 12, height = 20)
draw(vis_strain_N)
dev.off()
```

## Supplementary figure S3 updated (strain-summarized across replicates)

```{r}
# Same 20 metabolites as original S3 (top row SD on raw replicate values, not 0–3 counts)
wide_df_C <- wide_df[grepl("PM01|PM02A", rownames(wide_df)), ]

top20_media <- rownames(wide_df_C)[order(rowSds(as.matrix(wide_df_C)), decreasing = TRUE)[1:20]]
wide_df_sub_strain <- wide_df_strain[top20_media, , drop = FALSE]


rownames(wide_df_sub_strain) <- update_colnames(rownames(wide_df_sub_strain))
rownames(wide_df_sub_strain) <- sub(" _(PM01|PM02A)$", "", rownames(wide_df_sub_strain))
colnames(wide_df_sub_strain) <- sub("_", " ", colnames(wide_df_sub_strain))

vis_sub_strain <- Heatmap(

)
```
